# From common/scripted_guis/00_economic_scripted_guis.txt.

is_global_monetary_reference_more_button_visibility = {
	is_shown = {
		has_modifier = global_monetary_reference
	}
}
buy_sell_currency_in_gold_on_button_visibility = {
	is_shown = {
		var:sell_in_gold_on = 1
	}
}
#autre
has_gold_exchange_standard_tech_more_button_visibility = {
	is_valid = {
		has_technology_researched = gold_exchange_standard
	}
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = gold_exchange_standard
		var:sell_in_currency_on = 1
	}
}
has_gold_standard_no_gold_exchange_standard_tech_market_panel_visibility = {
	is_shown = {
		has_technology_researched = metalique_standard
		not = {
			has_technology_researched = gold_exchange_standard
			or  = {
				has_law = law_type:law_isolationism
				has_modifier = extreme_weak_currency
			}
		}
	}
}
currency_quantity_increase = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = currency_quantity
				var:currency_quantity < 20000000
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = currency_quantity
				add = 500000
			}
		}
	}
}
currency_quantity_reduce = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = currency_quantity
				var:currency_quantity > 500000
			}
			change_variable = {
				name = currency_quantity
				subtract = 500000
			}
		}
	}
}
############################################################################################################################################################
#in_gold - dinar
buy_dinar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_dinar_state
		player.valid_dinar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_dinar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_dinar_state
		valid_dinar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
dinar_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dinar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dinaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar }
	}
}
dinar_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dinar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dinaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dinaret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dinaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dinaret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dinaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar }
	}
}

					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dinar_algerian_dinaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dinar_algerian_dinar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_algerian_dinar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}

								name = stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_algerian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency

						}

		}

		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar_algerian_dinar }

#in_gold - dinar_iraqi_dinar
buy_dinar_iraqi_dinar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar_iraqi_dinar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state
		player.valid_dinar_iraqi_dinar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_dinar_iraqi_dinar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar_iraqi_dinar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state
		valid_dinar_iraqi_dinar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
dinar_iraqi_dinar_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dinar_iraqi_dinar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dinar_iraqi_dinaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_iraqi_dinar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_iraqi_dinar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_iraqi_dinar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_iraqi_dinar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_iraqi_dinar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_iraqi_dinar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar_iraqi_dinar }
	}
}

							var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_libyan_dinar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_libyan_dinar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_libyan_dinar_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dinar_libyan_dinaret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_libyan_dinar_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dinar_libyan_dinar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dinar_libyan_dinaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dinar_libyan_dinar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_libyan_dinar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}

							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_libyan_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency

						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar_libyan_dinar }
	}

#in_gold - dinar_moroccan_dirham
buy_dinar_moroccan_dirham_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar_moroccan_dirham > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state
		player.valid_dinar_moroccan_dirham_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_dinar_moroccan_dirham_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar_moroccan_dirham > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state
		valid_dinar_moroccan_dirham_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
dinar_moroccan_dirham_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dinar_moroccan_dirham } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dinar_moroccan_dirhamet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_moroccan_dirham_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_moroccan_dirham_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_moroccan_dirham_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_moroccan_dirham_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_moroccan_dirham_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_moroccan_dirham_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar_moroccan_dirham }
	}
}

				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_omanian_rial_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dinar_omanian_rialet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dinar_omanian_rialet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_omanian_rial_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_omanian_rial_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_omanian_rial_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dinar_omanian_rialet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dinar_omanian_rialet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_omanian_rial_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency

								name = stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_omanian_rial_c_in_reserve_currency

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar_omanian_rial }

#in_gold - dinar_qiran
buy_dinar_qiran_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar_qiran > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state
		player.valid_dinar_qiran_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_dinar_qiran_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar_qiran > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state
		valid_dinar_qiran_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dinar_qiran_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_qiran_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
dinar_qiran_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dinar_qiran } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dinar_qiranet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_qiran_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_qiran_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_qiran_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_qiran_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_qiran_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_qiran_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_qiran_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar_qiran }
	}
}

						add = owner.var:currency_quantity

			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar_saudi_riyal }

dinar_saudi_riyal_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dinar_saudi_riyal } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dinar_saudi_riyalet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_saudi_riyal_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_saudi_riyal_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_saudi_riyal_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dinar_saudi_riyalet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_saudi_riyal_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dinar_saudi_riyal_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dinar_saudi_riyalet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dinar_saudi_riyal_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_saudi_riyal_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_saudi_riyal_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_saudi_riyal_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_saudi_riyal_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_saudi_riyal_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {

								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_saudi_riyal_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dinar_saudi_riyal_currency
									}

							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {

						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {

dinar_tunisian_dinar_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dinar_tunisian_dinar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dinar_tunisian_dinaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_tunisian_dinar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_tunisian_dinar_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dinar_tunisian_dinaret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dinar_tunisian_dinaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dinar_tunisian_dinar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dinar_tunisian_dinar_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dinar_tunisian_dinaret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dinar_tunisian_dinaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dinar_tunisian_dinar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_tunisian_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar_tunisian_dinar }
	}
}

#in_gold - dinar_yugoslav_dinar
buy_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar_yugoslav_dinar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_state
		player.valid_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dinar_yugoslav_dinar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_state
		valid_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}

							name = stockpiling_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dinar_yugoslav_dinar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dinar_yugoslav_dinar }
	}
}

#in_gold - dollar_australian_dollar
buy_dollar_australian_dollar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dollar_australian_dollar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state
		player.valid_dollar_australian_dollar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_dollar_australian_dollar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dollar_australian_dollar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state
		valid_dollar_australian_dollar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dollar_australian_dollar_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dollar_australian_dollar_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}

dollar_australian_dollar_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dollar_australian_dollar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dollar_australian_dollaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_australian_dollar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_australian_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_australian_dollar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_australian_dollar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_australian_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_australian_dollar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dollar_australian_dollar }
	}
}
dollar_australian_dollar_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dollar_australian_dollar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}

			every_scope_state = {

					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place

				}
			}
		}

			save_scope_as = dollar_australian_dollaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_australian_dollar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_australian_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_australian_dollar_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dollar_australian_dollaret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dollar_australian_dollar_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dollar_australian_dollar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dollar_australian_dollaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dollar_australian_dollar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dollar_australian_dollar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_australian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dollar_canadian_dollar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dollar_canadian_dollaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dollar_canadian_dollar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dollar_canadian_dollar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {

								name = stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_canadian_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency

#in_gold - dollar_caribbean_dollar
buy_dollar_caribbean_dollar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dollar_caribbean_dollar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_dollar_caribbean_dollar_state
		player.valid_dollar_caribbean_dollar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_dollar_caribbean_dollar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dollar_caribbean_dollar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_dollar_caribbean_dollar_state
		valid_dollar_caribbean_dollar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dollar_caribbean_dollar_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dollar_caribbean_dollar_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
dollar_caribbean_dollar_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dollar_caribbean_dollar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dollar_caribbean_dollaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_caribbean_dollar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_caribbean_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_caribbean_dollar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_caribbean_dollar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_caribbean_dollar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_caribbean_dollar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_caribbean_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_caribbean_dollar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_caribbean_dollar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_caribbean_dollar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dollar_caribbean_dollar }
	}
}

						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dollar_confederate_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dollar_confederate_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dollar_confederate_states_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dollar_confederate_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_confederate_states_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_confederate_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_confederate_states_dollar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {

#in_gold - dollar_liberian_dollar
buy_dollar_liberian_dollar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dollar_liberian_dollar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_dollar_liberian_dollar_state
		player.valid_dollar_liberian_dollar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_dollar_liberian_dollar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dollar_liberian_dollar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_dollar_liberian_dollar_state
		valid_dollar_liberian_dollar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dollar_liberian_dollar_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dollar_liberian_dollar_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
dollar_liberian_dollar_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dollar_liberian_dollar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dollar_liberian_dollaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_liberian_dollar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_liberian_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_liberian_dollar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_liberian_dollar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_liberian_dollar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_liberian_dollar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_liberian_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_liberian_dollar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_liberian_dollar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_liberian_dollar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dollar_liberian_dollar }
	}
}

							multiply = money_value_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dollar_new_zealand_dollaret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dollar_new_zealand_dollaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_new_zealand_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency

			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {

#in_gold - dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar
buy_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_state
		player.valid_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_state
		valid_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dollar_sierra_leonean_dollaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dollar_sierra_leonean_dollar }
	}
}

						multiply = money_value_dollar_united_states_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_united_states_dollar_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = dollar_united_states_dollar }
	}
}
dollar_united_states_dollar_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = dollar_united_states_dollar } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = dollar_united_states_dollaret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_united_states_dollar_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_united_states_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_united_states_dollar_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dollar_united_states_dollaret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dollar_united_states_dollar_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dollar_united_states_dollar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dollar_united_states_dollaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dollar_united_states_dollar_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dollar_united_states_dollar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_dollar_united_states_dollar_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_dollar_united_states_dollar_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_dollar_united_states_dollar_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:dollar_united_states_dollaret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_dollar_united_states_dollar_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_dollar_united_states_dollar_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:dollar_united_states_dollaret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_dollar_united_states_dollar_currency

									has_law = law_type:law_dollar_united_states_dollar_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency

						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {

							var:stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_dollar_united_states_dollar_c_in_reserve_currency

#in_gold - eco_ariary
buy_eco_ariary_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_eco_ariary > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_eco_ariary_state
		player.valid_eco_ariary_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}

						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {

				law_eco_central_african_eco_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_central_african_eco_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_central_african_eco_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver

			scope:central_bank_site = {

				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
