eco_central_african_eco_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = eco_central_african_eco } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = eco_central_african_ecoet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_eco_central_african_eco_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_central_african_eco_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_central_african_eco_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:eco_central_african_ecoet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_central_african_eco_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_eco_central_african_eco_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:eco_central_african_ecoet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_eco_central_african_eco_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_central_african_eco_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_eco_central_african_eco_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_central_african_eco_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_central_african_eco_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:eco_central_african_ecoet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_central_african_eco_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_eco_central_african_eco_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:eco_central_african_ecoet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_eco_central_african_eco_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_central_african_eco_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_central_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = eco_central_african_eco }
	}
}

#in_gold - eco_east_african_eco
buy_eco_east_african_eco_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_eco_east_african_eco > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_eco_east_african_eco_state
		player.valid_eco_east_african_eco_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_eco_east_african_eco_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_eco_east_african_eco > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_eco_east_african_eco_state
		valid_eco_east_african_eco_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_eco_east_african_eco_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_eco_east_african_eco_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}

							var:stockpiling_eco_east_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_eco_east_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_eco_east_african_eco_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_eco_east_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_east_african_eco_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_east_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = eco_east_african_eco }
	}
}

#in_gold - eco_ethiopian_birr
buy_eco_ethiopian_birr_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_eco_ethiopian_birr > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state
		player.valid_eco_ethiopian_birr_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_eco_ethiopian_birr_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_eco_ethiopian_birr > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state
		valid_eco_ethiopian_birr_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_eco_ethiopian_birr_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_eco_ethiopian_birr_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}

eco_ethiopian_birr_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = eco_ethiopian_birr } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = eco_ethiopian_birret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_eco_ethiopian_birr_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_ethiopian_birr_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_ethiopian_birr_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_eco_ethiopian_birr_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_ethiopian_birr_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_ethiopian_birr_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = eco_ethiopian_birr }
	}
}
eco_ethiopian_birr_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = eco_ethiopian_birr } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)

				law_eco_ethiopian_birr_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_ethiopian_birr_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1

							multiply = money_value_eco_ethiopian_birr_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:eco_ethiopian_birret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_ethiopian_birr_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_eco_ethiopian_birr_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {

							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_eco_ethiopian_birr_currency

							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {

						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable

								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_eco_ethiopian_birr_c_in_reserve_currency

					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_ghanaian_pound_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_ghanaian_pound_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:eco_ghanaian_poundet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_ghanaian_pound_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_eco_ghanaian_pound_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:eco_ghanaian_poundet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_eco_ghanaian_pound_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_ghanaian_pound_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_ghanaian_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = eco_ghanaian_pound }
	}
}

#in_gold - eco_nigerian_naira
buy_eco_nigerian_naira_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_eco_nigerian_naira > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_eco_nigerian_naira_state
		player.valid_eco_nigerian_naira_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_eco_nigerian_naira_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_eco_nigerian_naira > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_eco_nigerian_naira_state
		valid_eco_nigerian_naira_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_eco_nigerian_naira_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_eco_nigerian_naira_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
eco_nigerian_naira_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = eco_nigerian_naira } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = eco_nigerian_nairaet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_eco_nigerian_naira_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_nigerian_naira_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_nigerian_naira_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_nigerian_naira_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_nigerian_naira_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_eco_nigerian_naira_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_nigerian_naira_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_nigerian_naira_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_nigerian_naira_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_nigerian_naira_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = eco_nigerian_naira }
	}
}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:eco_south_african_randet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_eco_south_african_rand_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_south_african_rand_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}

							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_south_african_rand_reserve_currency_state_1

#in_gold - eco_tuareg_ouguiya
buy_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_eco_tuareg_ouguiya > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_state
		player.valid_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_eco_tuareg_ouguiya > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_state
		valid_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
eco_tuareg_ouguiya_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = eco_tuareg_ouguiya } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = eco_tuareg_ouguiyaet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_tuareg_ouguiya_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = eco_tuareg_ouguiya }
	}
}

				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_west_african_eco_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = eco_west_african_eco }
	}
}
eco_west_african_eco_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = eco_west_african_eco } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = eco_west_african_ecoet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_eco_west_african_eco_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_eco_west_african_eco_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_eco_west_african_eco_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:eco_west_african_ecoet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_west_african_eco_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_eco_west_african_eco_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:eco_west_african_ecoet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_eco_west_african_eco_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_eco_west_african_eco_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_eco_west_african_eco_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {

						add = {

buy_franc_belgian_franc_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_franc_belgian_franc > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_franc_belgian_franc_state
		player.valid_franc_belgian_franc_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}

				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = franc_french_francet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_franc_french_franc_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_franc_french_franc_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_franc_french_franc_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_franc_french_franc_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_franc_french_franc_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_franc_french_franc_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = franc_french_franc }
	}

franc_french_franc_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = franc_french_franc } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = franc_french_francet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_franc_french_franc_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_franc_french_franc_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_franc_french_franc_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:franc_french_francet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_franc_french_franc_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_franc_french_franc_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:franc_french_francet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_franc_french_franc_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_franc_french_franc_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_franc_french_franc_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_franc_french_franc_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_franc_french_franc_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:franc_french_francet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_franc_french_franc_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_franc_french_franc_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:franc_french_francet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_franc_french_franc_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_franc_french_franc_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_french_franc_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_french_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = franc_french_franc }
	}
}

#in_gold - franc_luxembourgish_franc
buy_franc_luxembourgish_franc_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_franc_luxembourgish_franc > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state
		player.valid_franc_luxembourgish_franc_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_franc_luxembourgish_franc_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_franc_luxembourgish_franc > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_state
		valid_franc_luxembourgish_franc_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_franc_luxembourgish_franc_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_franc_luxembourgish_franc_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}

								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_luxembourgish_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = franc_luxembourgish_franc }
	}
}

#in_gold - franc_swiss_franc
buy_franc_swiss_franc_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_franc_swiss_franc > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state
		player.valid_franc_swiss_franc_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_franc_swiss_franc_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_franc_swiss_franc > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state
		valid_franc_swiss_franc_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
franc_swiss_franc_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = franc_swiss_franc } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = franc_swiss_francet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_franc_swiss_franc_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_franc_swiss_franc_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_franc_swiss_franc_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_franc_swiss_franc_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_franc_swiss_franc_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_franc_swiss_franc_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = franc_swiss_franc }
	}
}
franc_swiss_franc_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = franc_swiss_franc } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = franc_swiss_francet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_franc_swiss_franc_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_franc_swiss_franc_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_franc_swiss_franc_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:franc_swiss_francet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:franc_swiss_francet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_franc_swiss_franc_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_franc_swiss_franc_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_franc_swiss_franc_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:franc_swiss_francet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:franc_swiss_francet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_franc_swiss_franc_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_franc_swiss_franc_c_in_reserve_currency = 0

						name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:guldenet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_gulden_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_gulden_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_gulden_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = gulden }
	}
}

#in_gold - gulden_bavarian_gulden
buy_gulden_bavarian_gulden_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_gulden_bavarian_gulden > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state
		player.valid_gulden_bavarian_gulden_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}

gulden_bavarian_gulden_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = gulden_bavarian_gulden } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = gulden_bavarian_guldenet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_gulden_bavarian_gulden_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_gulden_bavarian_gulden_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_gulden_bavarian_gulden_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_gulden_bavarian_gulden_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_gulden_bavarian_gulden_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_gulden_bavarian_gulden_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_bavarian_gulden_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = gulden_bavarian_gulden }
	}
}

					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_gulden_florin_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_gulden_florin_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_gulden_florin_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:gulden_florinet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_gulden_florin_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_gulden_florin_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:gulden_florinet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_gulden_florin_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_gulden_florin_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_florin_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_florin_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = gulden_florin }
	}
}

#in_gold - gulden_hungarian_forint
buy_gulden_hungarian_forint_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_gulden_hungarian_forint > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_state
		player.valid_gulden_hungarian_forint_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_gulden_hungarian_forint_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_gulden_hungarian_forint > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_state
		valid_gulden_hungarian_forint_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_gulden_hungarian_forint_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_gulden_hungarian_forint_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
gulden_hungarian_forint_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = gulden_hungarian_forint } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = gulden_hungarian_forintet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_gulden_hungarian_forint_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_gulden_hungarian_forint_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_gulden_hungarian_forint_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_gulden_hungarian_forint_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_gulden_hungarian_forint_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_gulden_hungarian_forint_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_hungarian_forint_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = gulden_hungarian_forint }
	}
}

				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_gulden_indies_guilder_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:gulden_indies_guilderet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:gulden_indies_guilderet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_gulden_indies_guilder_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_gulden_indies_guilder_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_gulden_indies_guilder_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:gulden_indies_guilderet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:gulden_indies_guilderet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_gulden_indies_guilder_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_gulden_indies_guilder_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = gulden_indies_guilder }
	}
}

#in_gold - gulden_south_german_gulden
buy_gulden_south_german_gulden_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_gulden_south_german_gulden > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state
		player.valid_gulden_south_german_gulden_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_gulden_south_german_gulden_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_gulden_south_german_gulden > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state
		valid_gulden_south_german_gulden_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_gulden_south_german_gulden_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_gulden_south_german_gulden_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
gulden_south_german_gulden_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = gulden_south_german_gulden } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = gulden_south_german_guldenet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_gulden_south_german_gulden_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_gulden_south_german_gulden_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_gulden_south_german_gulden_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_gulden_south_german_gulden_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_gulden_south_german_gulden_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_gulden_south_german_gulden_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_gulden_south_german_gulden_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = gulden_south_german_gulden }
	}
}

krone_czech_koruna_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = krone_czech_koruna } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = krone_czech_korunaet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_krone_czech_koruna_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_krone_czech_koruna_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_krone_czech_koruna_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:krone_czech_korunaet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:krone_czech_korunaet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_krone_czech_koruna_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_krone_czech_koruna_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_krone_czech_koruna_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:krone_czech_korunaet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:krone_czech_korunaet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_krone_czech_koruna_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity

							var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {

								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_krone_czech_koruna_c_in_reserve_currency

							not  = {

#in_gold - krone_danish_krone
buy_krone_danish_krone_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_krone_danish_krone > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_state
		player.valid_krone_danish_krone_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_krone_danish_krone_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_krone_danish_krone > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_krone_danish_krone_state
		valid_krone_danish_krone_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_krone_danish_krone_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_krone_danish_krone_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}

		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_krone_estonian_kroon_state
		player.valid_krone_estonian_kroon_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
