			save_scope_as = peso_costa_rican_colonet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_costa_rican_colon_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_costa_rican_colon_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_costa_rican_colon_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_costa_rican_colonet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_costa_rican_colon_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_costa_rican_colon_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_costa_rican_colonet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_costa_rican_colon_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_costa_rican_colon_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_costa_rican_colon_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_costa_rican_colon_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_costa_rican_colon_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_costa_rican_colonet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_costa_rican_colon_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_costa_rican_colon_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_costa_rican_colonet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_costa_rican_colon_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_costa_rican_colon_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency

						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_costa_rican_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_costa_rican_colon }
	}
}

#in_gold - peso_cuban_peso
buy_peso_cuban_peso_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_cuban_peso > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_peso_cuban_peso_state
		player.valid_peso_cuban_peso_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_peso_cuban_peso_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_cuban_peso > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_peso_cuban_peso_state
		valid_peso_cuban_peso_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_peso_cuban_peso_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_cuban_peso_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}

peso_cuban_peso_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = peso_cuban_peso } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = peso_cuban_pesoet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_cuban_peso_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_cuban_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_cuban_peso_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_cuban_peso_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_cuban_peso_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_cuban_peso_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity

					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_cuban_peso_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_cuban_peso_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_cuban_peso_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_cuban_peso }
	}
}

peso_ecuadorian_peso_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = peso_ecuadorian_peso } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = peso_ecuadorian_pesoet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_ecuadorian_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_ecuadorian_peso_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_ecuadorian_pesoet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_ecuadorian_pesoet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_ecuadorian_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_ecuadorian_peso_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_ecuadorian_pesoet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_ecuadorian_pesoet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_ecuadorian_peso_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_ecuadorian_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_ecuadorian_peso }
	}
}

#in_gold - peso_el_salvador_colon
buy_peso_el_salvador_colon_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_el_salvador_colon > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_peso_el_salvador_colon_state
		player.valid_peso_el_salvador_colon_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_peso_el_salvador_colon_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_el_salvador_colon > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_peso_el_salvador_colon_state
		valid_peso_el_salvador_colon_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_peso_el_salvador_colon_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_el_salvador_colon_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}

								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_el_salvador_colon_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_el_salvador_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_el_salvador_colon_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_el_salvador_colon_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_el_salvador_colon }
	}
}

#in_gold - peso_guatemalan_quetzal
buy_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state
		player.valid_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state
		valid_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
peso_guatemalan_quetzal_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = peso_guatemalan_quetzal } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = peso_guatemalan_quetzalet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_guatemalan_quetzal }
	}
}
peso_guatemalan_quetzal_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = peso_guatemalan_quetzal } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = peso_guatemalan_quetzalet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_guatemalan_quetzalet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_guatemalan_quetzalet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_guatemalan_quetzalet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_guatemalan_quetzalet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_guatemalan_quetzal_c_in_reserve_currency

					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_honduran_lempira_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_honduran_lempira_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_honduran_lempiraet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_honduran_lempira_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_honduran_lempira_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_honduran_lempiraet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_honduran_lempira_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_honduran_lempira_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_honduran_lempira_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_honduran_lempira }
	}
}

#in_gold - peso_mexican_peso
buy_peso_mexican_peso_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_mexican_peso > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_state
		player.valid_peso_mexican_peso_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_peso_mexican_peso_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_mexican_peso > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_state
		valid_peso_mexican_peso_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_peso_mexican_peso_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_mexican_peso_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
peso_mexican_peso_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = peso_mexican_peso } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = peso_mexican_pesoet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_mexican_peso_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_mexican_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_mexican_peso_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_mexican_peso_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_mexican_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_mexican_peso_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_mexican_peso }
	}
}

						}

							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_mexican_peso_c_in_reserve_currency

									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_nicaraguan_cordobaet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_target

					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_nicaraguan_cordobaet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_nicaraguan_cordobaet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_currency

									has_law = law_type:law_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency < 0

						scope:central_bank_site_player = {

								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency

						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {

							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {

								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_nicaraguan_cordoba_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_nicaraguan_cordoba }

#in_gold - peso_paraguayan_peso
buy_peso_paraguayan_peso_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_paraguayan_peso > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_peso_paraguayan_peso_state
		player.valid_peso_paraguayan_peso_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_peso_paraguayan_peso_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_paraguayan_peso > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_peso_paraguayan_peso_state
		valid_peso_paraguayan_peso_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_peso_paraguayan_peso_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_paraguayan_peso_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
peso_paraguayan_peso_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = peso_paraguayan_peso } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = peso_paraguayan_pesoet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_paraguayan_peso_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_paraguayan_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_paraguayan_peso_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_paraguayan_peso_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_paraguayan_peso_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_paraguayan_peso_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_paraguayan_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_paraguayan_peso_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_paraguayan_peso_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_paraguayan_peso_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_paraguayan_peso }
	}
}

				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_philippine_peso_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_philippine_peso }
	}
}
peso_philippine_peso_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = peso_philippine_peso } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = peso_philippine_pesoet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_philippine_peso_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_philippine_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_philippine_peso_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_philippine_pesoet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_philippine_peso_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_philippine_peso_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_philippine_pesoet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_philippine_peso_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_philippine_peso_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_philippine_peso_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_philippine_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_philippine_peso_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_philippine_pesoet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_philippine_peso_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_philippine_peso_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_philippine_pesoet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_philippine_peso_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_philippine_peso_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_philippine_peso_reserve_currency_state_1

		}
		scope:player_country = {

				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place

			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1

						multiply = money_value_peso_uruguayan_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {

					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_uruguayan_peso_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_uruguayan_peso_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {

					}
				}
				change_variable = {

					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity

peso_uruguayan_peso_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = peso_uruguayan_peso } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = peso_uruguayan_pesoet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_uruguayan_peso_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_uruguayan_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_uruguayan_peso_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_uruguayan_pesoet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_uruguayan_pesoet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_peso_uruguayan_peso_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_peso_uruguayan_peso_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_peso_uruguayan_peso_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:peso_uruguayan_pesoet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:peso_uruguayan_pesoet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_peso_uruguayan_peso_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_uruguayan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_uruguayan_peso }
	}
}

#in_gold - peso_venezuelan_peso
buy_peso_venezuelan_peso_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_venezuelan_peso > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_state
		player.valid_peso_venezuelan_peso_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_peso_venezuelan_peso_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_peso_venezuelan_peso > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_state
		valid_peso_venezuelan_peso_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_peso_venezuelan_peso_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_peso_venezuelan_peso_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}

						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_peso_venezuelan_peso_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = peso_venezuelan_peso }
	}

#in_gold - pound_egyptian_pound
buy_pound_egyptian_pound_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_pound_egyptian_pound > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state
		player.valid_pound_egyptian_pound_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = {

		valid_pound_egyptian_pound_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {

pound_egyptian_pound_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = pound_egyptian_pound } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = pound_egyptian_poundet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_pound_egyptian_pound_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_pound_egyptian_pound_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_pound_egyptian_pound_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_pound_egyptian_pound_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_pound_egyptian_pound_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_pound_egyptian_pound_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_pound_egyptian_pound_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = pound_egyptian_pound }
	}
}

				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_pound_irish_pound_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:pound_irish_poundet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_pound_irish_pound_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_pound_irish_pound_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:pound_irish_poundet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_pound_irish_pound_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_pound_irish_pound_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_pound_irish_pound_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = pound_irish_pound }
	}
}

#in_gold - pound_sterling
buy_pound_sterling_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_pound_sterling > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_pound_sterling_state
		player.valid_pound_sterling_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_pound_sterling_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_pound_sterling > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_pound_sterling_state
		valid_pound_sterling_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_pound_sterling_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_pound_sterling_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
pound_sterling_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = pound_sterling } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = pound_sterlinget_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_pound_sterling_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_pound_sterling_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_pound_sterling_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_pound_sterling_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_pound_sterling_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_pound_sterling_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_pound_sterling_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = pound_sterling }
	}
}

					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_real_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:realet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_real_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_real_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_real_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:realet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_real_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_real_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_real_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_real_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_real_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_real_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_real_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = real }
	}
}

#in_gold - real_brazilian_real
buy_real_brazilian_real_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_real_brazilian_real > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state
		player.valid_real_brazilian_real_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_real_brazilian_real_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_real_brazilian_real > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state
		valid_real_brazilian_real_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_real_brazilian_real_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_real_brazilian_real_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}

real_brazilian_real_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = real_brazilian_real } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = real_brazilian_realet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_real_brazilian_real_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_real_brazilian_real_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_real_brazilian_real_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_real_brazilian_real_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_real_brazilian_real_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_real_brazilian_real_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_real_brazilian_real_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = real_brazilian_real }
	}
}

								name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_rupee_indian_rupee_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_rupee_indian_rupee_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_rupee_indian_rupee_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:rupee_indian_rupeeet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indian_rupee_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indian_rupee_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:rupee_indian_rupeeet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indian_rupee_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indian_rupee_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_rupee_indian_rupee_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = rupee_indian_rupee }
	}
}
