#in_gold - rupee_indonesian_rupiah
buy_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_rupee_indonesian_rupiah > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state
		player.valid_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_rupee_indonesian_rupiah > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state
		valid_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
rupee_indonesian_rupiah_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = rupee_indonesian_rupiah } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = rupee_indonesian_rupiahet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_rupee_indonesian_rupiah_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = rupee_indonesian_rupiah }
	}
}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_baht_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:spe_bahtet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_bahtet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_baht_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_baht_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1

				}

						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity

						}
					}
				}

				if = {

								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_bahtet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_baht_currency

						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {

								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_baht_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_baht_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {

#in_gold - spe_dong
buy_spe_dong_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_spe_dong > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_spe_dong_state
		player.valid_spe_dong_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_spe_dong_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_spe_dong > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_spe_dong_state
		valid_spe_dong_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_spe_dong_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_spe_dong_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
spe_dong_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = spe_dong } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = spe_donget_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_dong_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_dong_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_dong_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_dong_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_dong_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_dong_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_dong_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_dong_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_dong_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_dong_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = spe_dong }
	}
}

						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_drachma_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_drachma_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_drachma_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:spe_drachmaet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_drachma_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_drachma_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_drachma_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_drachmaet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_drachma_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_drachma_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_drachma_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_drachma_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_drachma_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_drachma_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_drachma_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_drachma_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_drachma_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_drachma_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_spe_drachma_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_spe_drachma_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_drachma_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_drachma_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_drachma_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_drachma_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {

						add = {

									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_drachma_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_drachmaet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_drachma_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {

							}
						}
					}
					if = {

#in_gold - spe_korean_won
buy_spe_korean_won_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_spe_korean_won > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_spe_korean_won_state
		player.valid_spe_korean_won_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_spe_korean_won_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_spe_korean_won > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_spe_korean_won_state
		valid_spe_korean_won_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_spe_korean_won_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_spe_korean_won_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
spe_korean_won_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = spe_korean_won } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = spe_korean_wonet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_korean_won_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_korean_won_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_korean_won_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_korean_won_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_korean_won_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_korean_won_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_korean_won_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_korean_won_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_korean_won_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_korean_won_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = spe_korean_won }
	}
}

spe_latvian_lats_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = spe_latvian_lats } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = spe_latvian_latset_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_latvian_lats_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_latvian_lats_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_latvian_lats_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:spe_latvian_latset_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_latvian_lats_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_latvian_lats_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_latvian_latset_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_latvian_lats_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_latvian_lats_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_latvian_lats_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_latvian_lats_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1

						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_latvian_lats_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {

				}
			}

						add = {

						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {

		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_peseta_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_peseta_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_peseta_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_peseta_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {

spe_peseta_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = spe_peseta } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = spe_pesetaet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_peseta_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_peseta_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_peseta_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:spe_pesetaet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_peseta_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_peseta_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_pesetaet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_peseta_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_peseta_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_peseta_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_peseta_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_peseta_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:spe_pesetaet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_peseta_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_peseta_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_pesetaet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_peseta_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_peseta_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_peseta_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_peseta_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = spe_peseta }
	}
}

buy_spe_ruble_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_spe_ruble > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_spe_ruble_state
		player.valid_spe_ruble_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}

				}
			}

		#gold

				law_spe_uni_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_uni_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_uni_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_uni_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_uni_state_1

					}
				}
			}
		}

spe_uni_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = spe_uni } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = spe_uniet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_uni_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_uni_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_uni_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_uni_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:spe_uniet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_uni_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_uni_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_uni_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_uniet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_uni_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_uni_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_uni_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_uni_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_spe_uni_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_uni_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_uni_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_uni_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_uni_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_uni_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:spe_uniet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_uni_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_uni_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_uni_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_uniet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_uni_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_uni_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {

						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_uni_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {

							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_uni_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}

							}

buy_spe_yen_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_spe_yen > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_spe_yen_state
		player.valid_spe_yen_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}

		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = spe_yuanet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_yuan_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_yuan_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_yuan_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_yuan_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_yuan_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}

spe_yuan_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = spe_yuan } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = spe_yuanet_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_yuan_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_yuan_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_yuan_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:spe_yuanet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_yuan_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_yuan_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_yuanet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_yuan_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_yuan_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_spe_yuan_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_spe_yuan_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_spe_yuan_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:spe_yuanet_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_yuan_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_spe_yuan_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:spe_yuanet_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_spe_yuan_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_spe_yuan_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_spe_yuan_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0

#in_gold - spe_zloti
buy_spe_zloti_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_spe_zloti > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_spe_zloti_state
		player.valid_spe_zloti_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_spe_zloti_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_spe_zloti > 0

		valid_spe_zloti_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_spe_zloti_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_spe_zloti_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}

sell_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state
		valid_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = thaler_hannoveraner_thaler } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = thaler_hannoveraner_thaleret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = thaler_hannoveraner_thaler }
	}
}
thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_sell_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = thaler_hannoveraner_thaler } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = thaler_hannoveraner_thaleret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}

			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:thaler_hannoveraner_thaleret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:thaler_hannoveraner_thaleret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					subtract = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
					add = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						add = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_target
						}
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						not = {
							scope:thaler_hannoveraner_thaleret_owner = {
								or = {
									has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
									any_subject_or_below = {
										has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
						subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:thaler_hannoveraner_thaleret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_thaler_hannoveraner_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = thaler_hannoveraner_thaler }
	}
}

				}

				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:thaler_prussian_thaleret_owner = {
							or = {
								has_law = law_type:law_thaler_prussian_thaler_currency
								any_subject_or_below = {
									has_law = law_type:law_thaler_prussian_thaler_currency
								}
							}
						}
					}

					#currency
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
						subtract = var:currency_quantity
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							owner.var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency = 0
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_state_1
								subtract = var:currency_quantity
							}
						}
					}
					if = {
						limit = {
							var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency < 0
						}
						set_variable = {
							name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							value = 0
						}
					}
					if = { #actualise la variable
						limit = {
							not  = {
								scope:central_bank_site_player.var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1 = var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							set_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_reserve_currency_state_1
								value = PREV.var:stockpiling_thaler_prussian_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		reset_debt_in_national_currency_player = yes
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = thaler_prussian_thaler }
	}
}

#in_gold - thaler_saxon_thaler
buy_thaler_saxon_thaler_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_thaler_saxon_thaler > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state
		player.valid_thaler_saxon_thaler_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
sell_thaler_saxon_thaler_in_gold_market_panel_enabled = {
	is_valid = {
		money_value_thaler_saxon_thaler > 0
		player.var:currency_quantity <= player.stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state
		valid_thaler_saxon_thaler_metal_reserve_type > buy_sell_currency_in_metal_market_panel
		or  = {
			has_law = law_type:law_thaler_saxon_thaler_currency
			any_subject_or_below = {
				has_law = law_type:law_thaler_saxon_thaler_currency
			}
		}
		not = {
			has_modifier = foreign_exchange_controls
		}
	}
}
thaler_saxon_thaler_buy_in_gold = {
	effect = {
		zz_ef_fxb_before = { CUR = thaler_saxon_thaler } # the button through the ledger (ld_fx_buttons.txt)
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_player = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = player_country
		}
		scope:player_country = {
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site_player
				}
			}
		}
		root = {
			save_scope_as = thaler_saxon_thaleret_owner
			every_scope_state = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_modifier = central_bank_historic_place
						is_capital = yes
					}
					save_scope_as = central_bank_site
				}
			}
		}

		#gold
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_thaler_saxon_thaler_monetary_system_GS_BS_GES_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = gold_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_thaler_saxon_thaler_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = gold_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_thaler_saxon_thaler_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		#silver
		if = {
			limit = {
				law_thaler_saxon_thaler_monetary_system_SS_trigger = yes
			}
			scope:central_bank_site = {
				#metal
				change_variable = {
					name = silver_state_1
					add = {
						value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
						multiply = money_value_thaler_saxon_thaler_target
					}
				}
				change_variable = {
					name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1
					subtract = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
				}
			}
			scope:player_country = {
				scope:central_bank_site_player = {
					#metal
					change_variable = {
						name = silver_state_1
						subtract = {
							value = scope:player_country.var:currency_quantity
							multiply = money_value_thaler_saxon_thaler_target
						}
					}
					change_variable = {
						name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1
						add = owner.var:currency_quantity
					}
				}
			}
		}
		zz_ef_fxb_after = { CUR = thaler_saxon_thaler }
	}
}

						}
						scope:central_bank_site_player = {
							change_variable = {
								name = stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_state_1
								add = PREV.var:stockpiling_thaler_saxon_thaler_c_in_reserve_currency
							}
						}
					}

sell_in_gold_on = {
	effect  = {
		set_variable = {
			name = sell_in_gold_on
			value = 1
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = sell_in_currency_on
			value = 0
		}
	}
}
sell_in_currency_on = {
	effect  = {
		set_variable = {
			name = sell_in_currency_on
			value = 1
		}
		set_variable = {
			name = sell_in_gold_on
			value = 0
		}
	}
}
